headline: Emirates airline may consider the possibility of launching regular flights to Uzbekistan
summary: Uzbekistan Airports and Emirates Group discussed Emirates entering the Uzbek market, reviewing airport infrastructure, passenger traffic and transit potential. The airline may consider opening scheduled flights after studying demand.
why: Emirates Group is the holding company of Dubai-based Emirates airline, and its route decisions affect air connectivity, tourism and aviation revenue in new markets.
